prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a hit while turning left. The patient had 29 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1038; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a collision in which the vehicle was struck while making a left turn. The reported mechanism is consistent with the knee injury described, and the force involved is in keeping with the structures affected. Care was delivered over 29 visits, beginning with conservative management including physical therapy, activity modification, and anti-inflammatory medication. Progress was steady, and visit frequency was reduced in a stepwise fashion as symptoms and range of motion improved. On examination, some findings, including effusion and pain with specific loading maneuvers, support the presence of an injury to the knee. Other provocative tests and neurovascular assessments were within normal limits. Records note a remote, minor strain involving the same region from several years ago, which had resolved completely without lasting limitation. Billing records reflect single entries for each service without duplicate or repeated charges. The patient was discharged to self-directed home exercise with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
